findings.current: The mountain lord[^1] who had ruled Mount Kunlun only a month ago lowered his now-larger-than-life body to greet his master.
findings.defect: “Larger-than-life” is figurative; the mountain lord’s body has physically grown larger than it was when he was alive.
findings.rationale: 살아 있을 적보다도 거대해진 explicitly compares his present size with his size while alive.
findings.replacement: The mountain lord[^1] who had ruled Mount Kunlun only a month ago bent his body, now larger than it had been in life, to greet his master.
findings.source: 살아 있을 적보다도 거대해진 몸뚱어리를 굽혀 자신의 주인을 맞이했다.

findings.current: Along with thousands of human demons who had, before then, surrounded Taiqing Hall—the very symbol of the Kunlun Sect—without leaving a single gap.
findings.defect: “Before then” makes the encirclement sound finished; the thousands are surrounding the hall at this moment.
findings.rationale: 둘러싸고 있던 describes their ongoing position around the hall.
findings.replacement: Along with thousands of human demons who now surrounded Taiqing Hall—the very symbol of the Kunlun Sect—without leaving a single gap.
findings.source: 어느덧 곤륜파의 상징과 같은 태청전(太淸殿)을 빈틈없이 둘러싸고 있던, 수천의 인마(人魔)와 함께.

findings.current: At the deaths of fully two thousand of their comrades, felled before they could take even one step into Henan.
findings.defect: They have already arrived in Henan; they die before taking their first step there, not before entering it.
findings.rationale: The formation has delivered them to the destination; 하남에서의 means “in Henan.”
findings.replacement: At the deaths of fully two thousand of their comrades, felled before they could take their first step in Henan.
findings.source:
그가 할 수 있는 일이라곤, 그저 멍하니 바라보는 것뿐이었다.

하남에서의 첫발을 떼기도 전에 쓰러진, 무려 이천에 달하는 아군들의 죽음을.

findings.current: He clicked his tongue, then added:
findings.defect: Clicking his tongue suggests disapproval; he smacks his lips as he surveys the survivors.
findings.rationale: 입맛을 다시며 describes a lip-smacking gesture, preserving his unsettling relish.
findings.replacement: He smacked his lips, then added:
findings.source: 살아남은 그의 수하들을 천천히 훑어본 중년인이 입맛을 다시며 덧붙였다.

findings.current:
For now, even understanding the two words filling his blank mind was more than he could manage.

*An ambush……!*

Yes, it was an ambush.

One laid with extraordinary care.
findings.defect: He can barely process the realization, rather than failing to understand it. 함정 is a trap, specifically the one laid in the formation, not an ambush.
findings.rationale: 이해하는 것만으로도 벅찼으니까 conveys the effort of grasping the realization; the repeated 함정 identifies the mechanism revealed immediately afterward.
findings.replacement:
For now, he could barely process the word filling his blank mind.

*A trap…!*

Yes, it was a trap.

One laid with extraordinary care.
findings.source:
지금 당장은 새하얗게 물든 뇌리를 가득 채운 두 글자를 이해하는 것만으로도 벅찼으니까.

‘함정……!’

그래, 이건 함정이었다.

그것도 아주 치밀하게 준비한.

findings.current: “I do. I’ll remember you—until after today.”
findings.defect: The draft reverses the timing of Ma Sanbao’s threat: he has remembered Zhuge Feng until now and expects to forget him after today.
findings.rationale: 기억하고 있었지 is retrospective; 오늘 이후로는 … 잊히겠지만 states that Zhuge Feng will leave his mind after today.
findings.replacement: “I do. I remembered you. After today, though, I’ll forget you.”
findings.source: “그래. 기억하고 있었지. 오늘 이후로는 머릿속에서 잊히겠지만.”

findings.current: No—at the age-old criminal who had dared to overthrow the imperial household.
findings.defect: “Age-old criminal” suggests the criminal is old; 천고 describes the magnitude of his treason.
findings.rationale: 천고의 죄인 condemns him as a criminal whose offense will be remembered for ages.
findings.replacement: No—at the criminal for the ages who had dared to overthrow the imperial household.

summary: Several errors alter the arrival, the trap, and Ma Sanbao’s reactions.
